headline: Home Minister Offers To Draft Resume For Opposition Leader To Help Him Find Employment In A New Sector
body: The Union Home Minister has formally offered to spend his weekend optimizing the opposition leader’s CV for the hospitality or retail sectors after noting a sustained lack of electoral success. The minister reportedly suggested that pivoting to a career in high-end lifestyle consulting might be more rewarding than the current professional trajectory.
caption: Guess who’s getting a LinkedIn makeover this weekend? The career counseling session nobody asked for has officially begun. #Politics #CareerAdvice #NewBeginnings (satire)
igHook: Would you hire the current opposition leader based on his recent track record?
